summary: Leonid Kulikov works in Indology and linguistics. He has held posts at Leiden University (attested 2007) and on the faculty at Ghent University (attested 2026).

Leopold Pospisil (1923–2021) studied at Charles University, Willamette University, the University of Oregon, and Yale University. He served as a professor at Yale from 1956 and curator at the Peabody Museum of Natural History (~1956–1993).

Leopold von Schroeder (1851–1920) was an Indologist who studied at Dorpat, Jena, and Tübingen, learning under Rudolf von Roth and Leo Meyer. He held posts at the University of Tartu, University of Innsbruck, and University of Vienna.

Leslie S. Kawamura (1935–2011) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He completed his PhD at the University of Saskatchewan under Herbert V. Guenther and was a professor at the University of Calgary from ~1976 to 2010.

Levi McLaughlin specializes in Japanology, religious studies, and Buddhist studies. He studied at the University of Tokyo and Princeton University, and has held posts at Kokugakuin University, Wofford College, and North Carolina State University.

Lewis Doney is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at SOAS University of London and has held posts at the University of Munich (attested 2018) and the University of Bonn (attested 2021).

Lewis Hodous (1872–1949) worked in Sinology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Case Western Reserve University, Hartford Seminary, and the University of Halle-Wittenberg, and held posts at Foochow Union Theological School and Hartford Seminary.

Lewis Lancaster is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Sinology who earned his PhD at the University of Wisconsin-Madison under Richard Hugh Robinson. He served as a professor at the University of California, Berkeley (~1967–2002).

id: P:Lha Zang Lama Rigdzin Gar Gyi Wangchuk
summary: Lha Zang Lama Rigdzin Gar Gyi Wangchuk studied under Jamgön Kongtrul Lodrö Thayé, Patrul Rinpoche, and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo.

Lhagpa Phuntshogs (1942–) is a Tibetologist. He served as president of the Tibetan Academy of Social Sciences (1983–1991), secretary-general of the China Society of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (1991–2000), and Director General of the China Tibetology Research Center (2000).

Lhakpa Tsering is a scholar of Tibetology and linguistics. He has served as a professor at Tibet University and as Assistant Professor of Tibetan Language and Literature at the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies (attested 2026).
Liang Cai works in Sinology and history/archaeology. She studied under Daniel Boucher and held a post as a junior scholar at the University of Arkansas (attested 2014).
Libbie Mills is an Indologist who completed her doctorate at the University of Oxford under Alexis Sanderson in 2011. She has taught Sanskrit and Pali at the University of Toronto (attested 2020).
Lili Zheng is a scholar of Buddhist studies. She studied at Fo Guang University, earning a Master of Arts under supervisor Yongdong Shi (attested 2011).
Lilian Silburn (1908–1993) worked in Indology, philosophy, and Buddhist studies. She studied under Paul Masson-Oursel and Lakshman Joo, and held a post at the CNRS from ~1948 to 1978.

Lilla Russell-Smith specializes in history/archaeology, Iranian and Central Asian studies, and Buddhist studies. She studied under Anna Eörsi and Pál Miklós, and earned a PhD from SOAS University of London.

Limei Chi works in Buddhist studies and Sinology and studied under Jinhua Chen. Her positions include faculty at the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies and professor at the International Institute for Buddhist Studies (both attested 2026).
Lin He (1902–1992) was a philosopher. He studied at Tsinghua University (~1919–1926) and later held an academic post there from ~1931 to 1952.
Lin Heng is an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who completed an MA at Silpakorn University under the supervision of Chainarong Klinnoi (attested 2015).

Linda Hogan (1964–) is a religious studies scholar who earned her PhD at Trinity College Dublin. She held posts at the University of Chester, University of Leeds, and Trinity College Dublin, including Vice-Provost (2011–2016).
